title: API Request Handlers
summary: This module defines the core API handlers for processing various requests like chat, generation, and model management (pull, push, show). It manages model loading, execution, and streaming responses, including handling cloud model proxies and debug rendering. It also includes comprehensive test suites for these functionalities.

nodes.label: External Client
nodes.title: External API Client
nodes.description: Represents users or applications interacting with the API endpoints to send requests and receive responses.

nodes.label: Chat Handler
nodes.title: Handle Chat API Requests
nodes.description: Processes incoming chat requests, managing model loading, prompt construction, LLM inference, and streaming responses. Supports tool calls, thinking capabilities, and structured outputs for dynamic interactions.

nodes.label: Generate Handler
nodes.title: Handle Generate API Requests
nodes.description: Processes incoming text generation requests, managing model loading, prompt construction, LLM inference, and streaming responses. Includes support for image generation, custom templating, and debug rendering of prompts.

nodes.label: Pull Handler
nodes.title: Handle Model Pull Requests
nodes.description: Manages pulling model data and metadata from external registries. Includes validation, progress reporting, and temporary handling of cloud model stubs for integration.

nodes.label: Push Handler
nodes.title: Handle Model Push Requests
nodes.description: Manages pushing local model data and metadata to external registries. Handles authentication, progress reporting, and ensures model integrity during upload.

nodes.label: Show Handler
nodes.title: Handle Model Show Requests
nodes.description: Retrieves and presents detailed configuration and metadata for a model. Includes caching, handling remote models, and user-agent specific overrides for display.

nodes.label: Web Experimental Passthrough
nodes.title: Proxy Experimental Web Endpoints
nodes.description: Forwards requests for experimental web endpoints (e.g., web search, web fetch) to a cloud proxy. Manages authentication, client versioning, and handles cloud service availability.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.title: Manage Model Lifecycle
nodes.description: Orchestrates the loading, unloading, and execution of language models, managing their availability and resource allocation.

nodes.label: Model Registry
nodes.title: Store & Retrieve Models
nodes.description: Manages the storage, retrieval, and metadata of local and remote models, facilitating model management operations.

nodes.label: Prompt Engine
nodes.title: Render Prompts
nodes.description: Processes messages, system instructions, and templates to construct the final, formatted prompt for the LLM, including image and tool integration.

nodes.label: LLM Runner
nodes.title: Execute Language Model
nodes.description: Performs inference using the loaded language model, generating text, images, or other outputs based on the provided prompt and options.

nodes.label: Tool Executor
nodes.title: Invoke External Tools
nodes.description: Executes external functions or services based on tool calls identified in the LLM's output, integrating external capabilities into the chat flow.

nodes.label: Cloud Inference
nodes.title: Remote LLM Inference
nodes.description: Provides remote language model inference capabilities, acting as an upstream service for cloud-based model requests.

nodes.label: API Middleware
nodes.title: Pre/Post-process Requests
nodes.description: Intercepts and modifies API requests and responses for various purposes, such as authentication, data transformation, or integrating web search functionality.

nodes.label: Test Cloud Passthrough
nodes.title: Test Cloud API Passthrough
nodes.description: Verifies that API requests for cloud models are correctly proxied to the upstream cloud service, including header and body transformations.

nodes.label: Test Debug Render
nodes.title: Test Debug Render Functionality
nodes.description: Validates the debug rendering feature for both chat and generate requests, ensuring prompts are rendered correctly without actual model inference.

nodes.label: Test Generate Renderer
nodes.title: Test Generate with Renderer
nodes.description: Ensures that the generate API correctly utilizes built-in prompt renderers for model-specific formatting, and handles custom templates or suffixes appropriately.

nodes.label: Test Chat Thinking
nodes.title: Test Chat Thinking & Structured Output
nodes.description: Verifies the chat handler's ability to process and stream 'thinking' content and structured outputs, including handling prompt modifications and context cancellations.

nodes.label: Test Image Generation
nodes.title: Test Image Generation
nodes.description: Validates the image generation capabilities of the generate API, ensuring image data is correctly passed to the LLM runner and responses are handled.

nodes.label: Test Logprobs
nodes.title: Test Log Probability Output
nodes.description: Confirms that both chat and generate API endpoints correctly return log probabilities when requested, including handling invalid `top_logprobs` values.

nodes.label: Test Model Lifecycle
nodes.title: Test Model Lifecycle Operations
nodes.description: Covers various model lifecycle operations like creation, deletion, and unloading via API requests, ensuring proper state management.

nodes.label: Test Harmony Streaming
nodes.title: Test Harmony Parser Streaming
nodes.description: Validates the streaming behavior of the chat API when using the Harmony parser, ensuring correct parsing of messages, thinking, and tool calls across multiple chunks.

nodes.label: Test General Routes
nodes.title: Test Core API Routes
nodes.description: Comprehensive testing of various core API routes including version, tags, create, copy, delete, and show, ensuring correct HTTP responses and data handling.

nodes.label: Test Web Experimental
nodes.title: Test Experimental Web Endpoints
nodes.description: Verifies the behavior of experimental web endpoints, including handling missing request bodies and scenarios where cloud services are disabled or unavailable.

groups.label: API Endpoints
groups.title: Core API Endpoints
groups.description: These components define the primary HTTP API endpoints for interacting with the Ollama server, handling various types of requests from external clients.

groups.label: Model Runtime
groups.title: Model Execution & Management
groups.description: Components responsible for orchestrating the loading, execution, and lifecycle management of language models, ensuring efficient resource utilization.

groups.label: Data & Configuration
groups.title: Data Handling & Prompt Preparation
groups.description: Components that manage model data storage, retrieval, and the dynamic construction of prompts based on user input, system instructions, and templates.

groups.label: Integration & Proxy
groups.title: External Service Integration
groups.description: Components facilitating interaction with external services, including remote cloud inference, external tool execution, and request/response middleware processing.

groups.label: Testing
groups.title: API Handler Test Suites
groups.description: A collection of test components that rigorously validate the functionality, error handling, and integration of the various API handlers within the module.
